title: The Vant Group
description: The Vant Group, founded in 1999, is an M&A advisory firm serving businesses up to $250M in revenue. It provides valuations, sell/buy-side advisory, and employee/partner buyouts, leveraging experienced professionals. Clients are mainly entrepreneurs and owners. Sector: Business Services & Finance General. Location: Dallas, Texas. Revenue: $15.7 million. Employees: 11-50.
